import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem algebra_9onxpypzleqsum2onxpy (x y z : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z) :
  9 / (x + y + z) ≤ 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
  rcases h₀ with ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩
  
  let a : ℝ := x + y
  let b : ℝ := y + z
  let c : ℝ := z + x
  let s : ℝ := x + y + z
  
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    dsimp [a]
    linarith
  
  have hb : 0 < b := by
    dsimp [b]
    linarith
  
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    linarith
  
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    linarith
  
  have hsrel : 2 * s = a + b + c := by
    dsimp [a, b, c, s]
    ring
  
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ a * (b - c) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt ha) (sq_nonneg (b - c))
  
  have h₂ : 0 ≤ b * (c - a) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hb) (sq_nonneg (c - a))
  
  have h₃ : 0 ≤ c * (a - b) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hc) (sq_nonneg (a - b))
  
  have hN :
      0 ≤ 2 * s * (b * c + a * c + a * b) - 9 * a * b * c := by
    rw [hsrel]
    nlinarith [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  
  have hden : 0 < s * a * b * c :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos hs ha) hb) hc
  
  have hdiff :
      2 / a + 2 / b + 2 / c - 9 / s =
        (2 * s * (b * c + a * c + a * b) - 9 * a * b * c) /
          (s * a * b * c) := by
    field_simp [hs.ne', ha.ne', hb.ne', hc.ne'] <;> ring
  
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 2 / a + 2 / b + 2 / c - 9 / s := by
    rw [hdiff]
    exact div_nonneg hN (le_of_lt hden)
  
  change 9 / s ≤ 2 / a + 2 / b + 2 / c
  linarith
